title: The Tanker Shortage: Why Moving Oil Remains a Challenge
section_path: The Tanker Shortage: Why Moving Oil Remains a Challenge
section_path_text: The Tanker Shortage: Why Moving Oil Remains a Challenge
summary:
Main
By Panagiota Kinti
The global oil market is facing a challenge that goes beyond crude supply. The new challenge is to find enough available ships to move it. Despite the recovery in Middle Eastern exports during September, geopolitical tensions and disrupted shipping patterns continue to put pressure on tanker availability.
